blurb: SB Jet Ski Rentals offers jet ski experiences and training in Maryland. They provide top-of-the-line jet ski tours and emphasize safety and reliability. The owner, Captain SB, oversees safety protocols and risk management to ensure passenger well-being.
extraNote: All bookings must be made through our official online booking system with full payment at booking. · Guests may reschedule their booking up to 12 hours before the scheduled start time, subject to availability. · Cancellations made 12 hours or more before the scheduled booking time are eligible for a full refund. · Cancellations made less than 12 hours before the booking time are not eligible for a refund. · If the company cancels due to weather or safety, guests get a full refund or rescheduling at no cost. · Reckless operation may result in removal without refund.
